subject: Long-context costing recap + budget ask
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Luka Petrovic <luka@finstream.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 12:14:00 +0200
Subject: Long-context costing recap + budget ask

Hi Luka / Elena —

Thanks again for the demo and the call earlier — really appreciate the clarity on the FinStream use cases. This note is a short post-call recap and a few concrete asks that will let us put together an accurate cost / pilot proposal for your team.

Recap (what I heard)
- Primary product: AI-driven article summarization + legal risk flags.
- Expected production traffic (phase 1): ~8–15M tokens / month (mix of prompts + completions).
- Typical prompt size for summarization flows: 150–220 tokens.
- Typical completion length: 400–900 tokens depending on length of article and desired summary depth.
- Occasional long-context needs: regular 32k runs for full-article context; rare 128k sessions for multi-document legal ingests.
- Latency requirement: p95 per-call under 900ms for user-facing flows; background batch jobs can be relaxed.

Asks (to finalize pricing options) — could you confirm the following?
1) Monthly token band you expect for the next 6–12 months (low / typical / high). Example: 3M / 10M / 20M.
2) Average prompt tokens and average completion tokens by traffic type (user-facing vs. batch).
3) Frequency of 32k vs 128k runs (est % of calls).
4) Target $/1M tokens you are aiming for (ballpark) and any budget guardrails for phase 1.
5) Any compliance or data residency constraints beyond EU-only storage.

Attachments: I attached a one-page mutual action plan (MAP) that outlines milestones we typically use for pilot -> production (mutual_action_plan.pdf). Also included a small CSV template (sample_prompt_profile.csv) you can paste a few sample prompts into — that helps our infra team produce a realistic cost projection.

Next steps I propose
- You send back the items above (1–4) and paste 3 representative prompt/completion pairs into the CSV.
- We schedule a 45-min technical deep dive with our solutions engineer (please suggest Tue/Wed next week).
- I’ll produce a tiered pricing model (hosted + committed dedicated options) and a short TCO sketch that shows impact of batching / cache on $/1M tokens.

Thanks — Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan.pdf (PDF)]
[Attachment: sample_prompt_profile.csv (CSV)]

From: Luka Petrovic <luka@finstream.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena García <elena.garcia@finstream.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 14:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Long-context costing recap + budget ask

Hi Neha —

Great write-up, thanks. Below are the numbers I can confirm now; happy to fill in more detail once I have access to your CSV template (I used the attached examples inline).

High-level traffic bands (month):
- Low: 5M tokens
- Typical: 12M tokens
- High: 28M tokens (post-feature launch)

Prompt / completion averages (by flow):
- User-facing summarization: prompt ~180 tokens, completion ~520 tokens (real-time).
- Background quality scoring / rerank: prompt ~80 tokens, completion ~120 tokens (batch).
- Legal ingestion (document-level): prompt (context) varies widely — when we need full-doc ingestion ~25k–40k tokens; very occasionally (peak audits) we may require >100k tokens across a multi-doc session (estimated 0.5% of sessions).

Frequency of larger windows:
- 32k runs: estimated 3% of total calls (article-level operations).
- 128k windows: estimated 0.25% (audit/legal bundles).

Budget target and constraints:
- Initial procurement target: $600–$750 per 1M tokens for hosted inference during pilot (we’re a startup but have runway for a strategic price).
- If we can get to $500/1M with a committed 12-month volume, we will consider a Dedicated/reserved conversation.
- EU-only data residency required; SOC 2 evidence is a must.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll paste 4 sample prompt/completion pairs into the CSV and return it by EOD Wednesday.
- We’d like the technical deep dive next Wednesday 16:00 CEST if that works.

Cheers,
Luka

--
Luka Petrovic
Head of ML | FinStream
luka@finstream.ai
[Inline: sample examples provided in CSV columns]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Long-context costing recap + budget ask

Looping in a couple of quick recommendations before we respond to FinStream. Short bullets so Neha can include in reply.

- Pricing posture: FinStream’s $600–$750/1M hosted target for pilot is reasonable to start; push to $550/1M with a 12-month commit and opt-in for batching/kv-cache. Make the $500/1M a tier contingent on 24-month committed throughput and small ramp.
- Hybrid recommendation: Hosted API for user-facing summarization (fast onboarding) + Dedicated reserved nodes for nightly legal batch ingest if they can commit to minimum sustained throughput. Dedicated helps control p95 for high-volume text and reduces unit cost if we can amortize GPU cycles.
- Context windows: propose three SKU tiers — 8k (default), 32k (recommended for their regular article flows), 128k (add-on priced per-hour or per-batch). Make 128k explicitly usage-billed at a premium so we protect for infrequent heavy runs.
- Technical ask: SE should test with their 4 sample prompts and one 40k doc; results back to FinStream with latency + cost per call.
- Compliance: send SOC2/ISO docs; confirm EU region in contract.

Neha: I drafted a short MAP section that makes the price-slots and commitment language explicit. Suggest you offer a 30-day pilot with capped spend and a follow-up proposal for committed discounts.

-Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Head of Sales | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai
[Internal note: push for 12mo commit, protect margin on 128k runs]

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Luka Petrovic <luka@finstream.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Long-context costing recap + budget ask

Hi Luka —

Appreciate the detailed numbers — this is exactly what helps us model economics. Next steps on our side and proposed provisional pricing tiers: please review and confirm.

Technical deep dive: we can do Wed 30 Jun at 16:00 CEST. Our SE (Ivan) will join and run live tests on the 4 samples + one 40k doc you provide.

Provisional pricing (pilot 30 days, hosted):
- Tier A (baseline): $750 / 1M tokens — includes 8k/32k standard runs, 24/7 support during pilot.
- Tier B (preferred): $600 / 1M tokens — requires 12-month committed minimum of 9M tokens/mo averaged across contract, includes KV caching and 2% rebate for sustained usage.
- Tier C (enterprise reserved): $500 / 1M tokens — requires 24-month commitment and forecasting, Dedicated capacity option recommended for cost-efficiency.

128k window: billed as an add-on at $1200 / 1M tokens equivalent for that session-class (or we can quote per-hour reserved 128k node pricing if you prefer reserved runs).

Compliance: attaching our SOC 2 summary and the MAP; I’ll open a separate secure share for SOC2 docs if you confirm EU-only hosting.

Ask from FinStream (action items for you):
1) Confirm which pricing tier you want us to model for the demo (A / B / C).
2) Share the 4 sample prompt/completion rows + one 40k doc (or a link).
3) Confirm you accept EU-only data residency.

If you agree, I’ll prepare a short pilot SOW + the draft MAP for signature and a DocuSign link for the pilot commitment (no upfront surprise charges; the pilot will be capped).

Thanks — looking forward to the deep dive.

Best,
Neha

--
